d: Indian authorities sent Google 4,006 content takedown requests between January and June 2026, up 61% in six months, according to Google's transparency report. The police sent seven in 10 of them, and most targeted YouTube. Meta restricted 54.4 lakh posts in India in the same period, about 131 times more than in the six months before. Platforms now get three hours to act on takedown orders, and police can send notices directly through the Home Ministry's Sahyog portal. Vrinda Tulsian explains.
